book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: N'yɛyɛ wu Joŋ Nlesɛajoo
Gɛ̀ bee kife kɛɛ le, Joŋ Nlesɛajoo ja wu bunɛ wu gɛɛŋ kwa kimbe ki woŋ kì Judia le wu tu wu feeji bamii le lɛ,
“Bɛŋ kusɛ muntele mwɛna, nje bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le wa mbebe le.”
Joŋ wunɛ le muh wù Yosaya wù muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ jɛme kune wu sege wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,
Joŋ gɛ̀ jiide njú yì ba kɛnyɛ bɛ yvú yi nyaŋ yimi yì ba tɛŋe lɛ kamɛɛ, wu kaane kicha chiŋ ba kɛnyɛ bɛ je yi nyaŋ, mwɛɛ mwe munjile gɛ̀ bee chuma bɛ bvutu bvu nchvuuŋ.
No wu gɛ̀ feeji noo, bamii tu bo bude Yɛlusalɛm bɛ bantɛ le bachii ba Judia mo bimbe bi mbebe Joo yì Jodaŋ le bichii, bo gɛɛne fɛ wu le.
No bo gɛɛne noo bo sɛŋe bimbefɛ biboo, wu mo wu leese bo a Joo yì Jodaŋ le.

Geenɛ, wu gɛ̀ doo wu yɛŋ Bafalashii bɛ Basadushii bamu le wesee bo too lɛ wu leesɛ bo a joo, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Kiŋgogɛ ki yó lɛ, teefe yɛɛŋ bɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ lêge shɛ́ŋ yi Nyo yì bɛɛne wu yì wu lé wu gê wu dûnyɛ bɛŋ le, fɛ bɛŋ too nɛ?
Bɛŋ gêe mwɛɛ mù duunyi lɛ bɛŋ le bɛŋ kusɛ wa muntele mwɛna.
Keefɛ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ dûu gɛh fɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna le lɛ Ablaham le chiji wene gɛ. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ taŋlo Nyo fiisɛ ata kanɛ wo tu booŋ ba Ablaham.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ ba le ba gɛɛ wa tɛmɛ fɛ binyi bi bite le. Kite kichii kì baaŋ yuŋ gɛ muntaŋ mù njoŋe gɛ, tu ba lé ba gwô nɛ ba lee ba gɛɛŋ yi gɛŋ le, ba toŋ lo.

Nleese bɛŋ a joo nje bɛŋ le bɛŋ kusɛ wa muntele mwɛna. Geenɛ muh wù too a mɛ jiŋ kuge wu fede mɛ. Jé ye, gɛ ŋkooji ki ntuu gɛ. Wu lé wu gê wu leese fie bɛŋ nyu chiaaŋ yi Kiyo ki Yuude le, mo yi ŋgu le.
Wu kɛme fiɛɛ fie abo fì wu fɛɛde agiŋ yu, wu lé wu yɛ̂ɛsɛ fɛ wu fɛ̂ɛde, wu bânyɛ agiŋ wu gɛ̂ɛ a ŋwaŋ le, wu mo wu kôo munyi wu toŋ bɛ ŋgu wu fiee wu jime gɛ.”
Joŋ leesɛ Jiso a joo
No Joŋ gɛ̀ leese bamii a joo noo, Jiso mo wu ja kimbe ki woŋ kì Galalee le wu to fɛ Joo yì Jodaŋ le lɛ Joŋ leesɛ tɛ wu a joo.
Geenɛ Joŋ tu wu faŋe wu duu lɛ, “Le wo wù be kɛme ki wo lêesɛ mɛ a joo, wo katu too fɛ mɛne nɛ nɛɛ?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Chînɛ fi nyume noo mɛɛse! Le yi yinɛ je le yì besa wo lé be gê fiɛɛ fichii fi nyu chaaŋ a Nyo jii.”

content: Noo, Joŋ mo wu bɛɛŋ, wu leesɛ Jiso a joo.
Gɛh no Jiso gɛ̀ bude a joo, kibvulɛ gwenyɛ ye, Kiyo ki Nyo shii ki to ye ye le fiɛɛnɛ kibɛmbɛ.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ, jɛ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ fɛwe lɛ, “Wunɛ le Mwa yaŋ. Wu le fitele fiaŋ. N'yuge njoŋ bɛ wu baaŋ.”
